name: Crown of the Earth
summary: In Teldrassil, moonwell waters are gathered to tend the World Tree’s sickness. The rites lead to Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm in Darnassus, where concern grows over a tree raised without blessings.

sections.title: A Flawed Genesis
sections.body: Teldrassil rose after the Third War to give the night elves a new home and restore their lost immortality. The Great Aspects Alexstrasza and Nozdormu withheld their blessings and refused to sanction its creation. Without their divine protection, sickness spreads through the tree. Strange creatures emerge from its boughs, and once-peaceful furbolg tribes fall into madness.

sections.title: Delivery to the Arch Druid
sections.body: Corithras Moonrage sends young adventurers to gather water from moonwells across Teldrassil, hoping to study and soothe the tree’s ailments. He gathers the samples into one vessel and sends you deep into Darnassus, to the Cenarion Enclave. Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm, who shaped Teldrassil, sees the spreading corruption as a burden he alone must solve.

faq.q: Why does Fandral Staghelm want this moonwell water?
aliases: why does fandral need the vessel
faq.answer: Fandral Staghelm wants the moonwell samples to study and address the corruption spreading through the World Tree. As the leader who championed Teldrassil’s planting, he bears responsibility for finding a remedy for the strange beasts and maddened furbolgs in its canopy.

faq.q: Why is Teldrassil plagued by corruption and crazed beasts?
faq.answer: Teldrassil suffers corruption and strange beasts because it was planted without the blessings of Alexstrasza the Life-Binder or Nozdormu the Timeless. Unlike the ancient World Tree Nordrassil, it lacks the protection of those primal dragon aspects, leaving its growth flawed and allowing malignancies to warp nearby wildlife and furbolgs.

faq.q: Where is Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm located?
faq.answer: Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm is in the Cenarion Enclave in Darnassus. You can find him atop the central druid pavilion, overlooking the enclave’s sacred groves.

aliases: who gives crown of the earth
faq.answer: Corithras Moonrage is a night elf stationed at Dolanaar who sends young adventurers to fill phials at Teldrassil’s moonwells. He pours their waters into one vessel and directs couriers to deliver it to Arch Druid Staghelm in Darnassus.

faq.q: What happens after completing this quest?
aliases: crown of the earth follow up
what comes after crown of the earth 6
next quest after crown of the earth
faq.answer: You deliver the filled vessel to Fandral Staghelm, ending the main Crown of the Earth chain in Teldrassil. He accepts the water curtly and turns back to the wider threats facing the night elf homeland.

faq.q: Why is Fandral Staghelm so dismissive upon receiving the vessel?
faq.answer: Fandral Staghelm is proud and impatient, and he bears the burden of leading the Cenarion Circle while Malfurion Stormrage is absent. He disdains administrative setbacks and slow messengers, believing Teldrassil’s survival rests on his shoulders.

angles.text: As a night elf, you see the worry beneath your new home: Teldrassil was planted in pride without the Dragon Aspects’ blessings, and its sickness threatens your people’s fresh start.

As a druid, carrying moonwell waters brings you before Fandral Staghelm, Arch Druid of the Cenarion Circle. His presence reveals the fierce political and spiritual divide among druids while Malfurion is absent.
As an Alliance member, you see Darnassus as a capital of ancient mystery, while the corrupted wilderness around it shows that peril reaches the night elves even on their sacred ground.
